description: This file defines the EmployeeContactDetailsModel class, a model representing an employee's contact details within the OrangeHRM system's API layer. It uses traits for serialization and implements an interface for normalization, providing a structured way to expose employee contact information via the API.

classes.name: EmployeeContactDetailsModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing employee contact details for API responses, utilizing traits for common serialization logic and implementing normalization for consistent data output.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an Employee entity and sets filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
